document_title: P1 Non-Debug Cue and Source Inventory (REV2)
author: Antigravity (Visual & Technical Animation Investigator)
counting_rule: Denominator is the set of 14 named evidenced attack route variants across the live encounter, cleanly separating pack-authored montages and project-swapped replacement montages into independent records with unmixed clock domains: 9 pack-authored variants (A1-Pack, A1b-Branch, A2-Pack, A3a-Pack, A3b-Pack, A6-Pack, Mid01-Pack, Sprint-Pack, Retaliation-Pack), 3 project-swapped variants (A1-Project, A3a-Project, A3b-Project), and 2 native project special routes (A4 Low Sweep, A5 Javelin Throw). Non-damaging utility and system abilities (TurnInPlace, HitStun, EnterCombat, ExitCombat, RagdollDeath) are excluded from the attack denominator.

consolidated_export_requests.description: Export raw AnimSequence notify tracks for AN_Boss01_A4_LowSweep and AN_Boss01_A5_JavelinThrow. (Source audit of RPGAttackTracker.cpp:169 confirms dynamic montage wrappers are generated transiently in memory via PlaySlotAnimationAsDynamicMontage, not stored as authored .uasset montages).
Export pin connections of the sprint-to-followup transition in GA_GS_Boss_SprintAttack to measure the exact runtime lead time of the run-up phase prior to GS_SprintAttackFollowUp_Montage.
Sample grayscale luminance values of candidate non-color combat visual effects against dark stone floor geometry in L_SevarogArena to establish accessibility contrast ratio.
